english.title: Use trailer - manufacturer's plate not displayed
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a wheeled goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when you failed to ensure that the manufacturer's plate issued in respect of trailer, identification number **(..SPECIFY TRAILER IDENTIFICATION NUMBER..), being drawn by that vehicle, was securely affixed to the vehicle so as to be legible at all times in a conspicuous and readily accessible position
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 66(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), drawing a trailer which did not display the Manufacturer's plate in the prescribed manner.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

Fixed penalty ticket - fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
